name: jiscribe-desktop
description: The Jiscribe MCP server as a desktop app (PoC): AI clients connect to it over Streamable HTTP, and its own window shows the canvas viewer.

comments.dependencies: Bundled into out/main/index.js along with everything they pull in (externalizeDeps is off). What jiscribe-mcp resolves at run time instead of importing — the viewer, the drawing guides and the measuring fonts — is copied out of its built dist/ by stageMcpRuntime.mjs, so jiscribe-mcp has to be built first.
